title: Split the internals page into loader utilities and client modules
description:
`website/src/pages/internals.astro` is carrying too much responsibility in one file. It is 1786 lines long and mixes server-side file loading, Astro markup, CSS, and three separate chunks of client-side behavior: trends charting, model-stats table logic, and blunder-analysis charting.

There is already visible duplication inside the page: `UNRELIABLE_CACHE_MODELS` and `hasUnreliableCache` are defined twice, once for the trends chart and once for the model-stats table. The page also reaches directly into `../puppeteer/tests/golden/exports` and parses fixture files inline.

Clean this up by moving:
1. Golden fixture discovery/loading into a server-side utility.
2. Trends chart logic into a dedicated client module.
3. Model-stats table logic into a dedicated client module.
4. Blunder chart logic into a dedicated client module.
5. Shared helpers like cache-model detection into a shared utility.

The goal is not cosmetic line-count reduction alone. The current shape makes it hard to test, reason about, or reuse any of the logic without reopening one giant page file.
